sonnet.problem: The True statement repeats what story card 7 just told: that Jesus has already glorified the Father on earth. It adds only the 'by accomplishing the work' detail, so it restates the card before it.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: The joke about the 25-cent sticker and the closing bakery bin has no shared action with Jesus asking for the glory He had before the world existed. A baker would likely say 'huh?'.
sonnet.rule: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

sonnet.problem: The joke says Papa Dorin would be 'begging for the EXIT'. That has no shared action with 'not of the world' and implies wanting out of the world, which clashes with Jesus saying in the next verse (15) that He is not asking the Father to take them out. The line does not make sense.
sonnet.rule: If a stranger would say "huh?", rewrite it.

sonnet.problem: Story card 3 restates the answer baker just gave on choice card 2: the prayer reaches people who would believe later. Verse 20 is told again before the new verse 21 material.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
